title: 「我不会卖掉 Apple」：这位市场策略师认为板块轮动「健康」，长期看好 Micron
author: Stocktwits News Feed
content:
Even as volatility in the technology sector has the markets making wild swings, Kenny Polcari, Partner and Chief Market Strategist at SlateStone Wealth, believes that investors are finding stability and opportunity elsewhere. 

In an interview with Schwab Network on Tuesday, Polcari noted that despite continued pressure on the technology sector, consumer discretionary, staples, utilities, and financials were among eight of the 11 S&P 500 sectors that gained on Monday.

“And so there's this move out of tech, but into other parts of the market. Investors are finding stability and opportunity,” he said.

Selloff In Tech Names Is An Opportunity, Polcari Says 

Meanwhile, the market strategist said that as the market is testing a “reset,” the Nasdaq could slip to 24,000, which is about 5% lower than current levels. 

He noted that while some individual stocks are “already well into bear market territory,” with some technology names down more than 20%, it has created a buying opportunity, “especially in some of the bigger, high-quality names that are getting really punished just because there's this sense that maybe large asset managers are trying to reduce some of their exposure to tech, and so they just sell everything to bring everything in line.”

Polcari named Micron Technology (MU) as one of the top long-term picks, despite its volatility. “I think MU long term is a name I like. I own it. The firm owns it. I think you have to be willing to put up with the volatility because it's happened multiple times,” he said, adding that “if you're taking a long-term view, I think it's a name that you have to have.”

Advertisement|Remove ads.

Polcari also said that Apple Inc. (AAPL) was “priced to perfection,” as its quarterly revenues soared to over $114 billion despite missing margins by one percentage point. “Because look, if you look at what's happened to Apple over the last month, while tech was under pressure, Apple's actually making new highs, right? And so this pullback, I'm not really surprised by it. But I'm not selling my Apple,” he said. 

What The Rotation Says

The market strategist believes that the overall market rotation is “very healthy” as there is no evidence of a massive, all-market selloff. 

He said that while the S&P 500 market capitalization was down half a percent because of technology, the equal-weight S&P 500 was up seven-tenths of a percent due to gains in other sectors. 

Advertisement|Remove ads.

“And so that just suggests, again, that buyers, that investors, are finding opportunity in some other sectors going forward, right? They're not looking for today and tomorrow. They're long-term investors. They're buying stuff because they think the future looks positive for them,” he said. 

How Are Markets Reacting?

Among ETFs tracking benchmark indexes, the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY), which tracks the S&P 500, is up more than 11% year-to-date. However, it is down about 1% so far this quarter. 

Meanwhile, the Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ), which tracks the Nasdaq, is up nearly 12% so far this year, but has declined more than 7% so far this quarter.

The SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF Trust (DIA) is up nearly 2% quarter-to-date, and has gained nearly 9% year-to-date.

oneSentenceSummary: 市场策略师 Kenny Polcari 认为，资金从科技股转向防御性板块的轮动是健康的；他推荐长期持有 Micron，并表示尽管市场波动，仍会继续持有 Apple。
summary: SlateStone Wealth 首席市场策略师 Kenny Polcari 在接受 Schwab Network 采访时，谈到了市场板块轮动的情况。他指出，科技股持续承压，但标普 500 的 11 个板块中有 8 个上涨，其中非必需消费品、必需消费品、公用事业和金融板块表现领先。Polcari 将这轮轮动称为「非常健康」，并表示没有迹象显示市场正在普遍抛售。他指出，纳斯达克指数可能会测试 24，000 点，较当前水平低约 5%。尽管部分科技股跌幅超过 20%，「已深陷熊市区域」，Polcari 仍认为优质股票存在买入机会。他特别推荐 Micron Technology（MU）作为首选长期投资标的，并强调投资者需要能够承受波动。谈及 Apple（AAPL）时，Polcari 表示，考虑到其季度营收达到 $114 billion，股价「已被完美定价」，但他仍表示不会卖出手中的股票。市场 ETF 表现不一：SPY 年初至今上涨 11%，但本季度下跌 1%；QQQ 年初至今上涨近 12%，但本季度下跌超过 7%；DIA 本季度上涨近 2%，年初至今上涨 9%。

mainPoints.point: 资金从科技股转向防御性板块的轮动是健康的，没有证据表明市场正在普遍抛售。
mainPoints.explanation: 标普 500 的 11 个板块中有 8 个上涨。由于科技股权重较高，等权重标普 500 上涨 0.7%，而市值加权指数下跌 0.5%；这表明投资者正在其他领域寻找机会，而不是全面撤出市场。

mainPoints.point: 尽管波动较大，Micron Technology 仍是值得长期投资的标的。
mainPoints.explanation: Polcari 明确表示：「从长期来看，MU 是我看好的标的。我持有，公司的投资组合也持有。」他强调，长期投资者必须能够承受这种波动，而这类波动在该公司历史上已多次出现。

mainPoints.point: Polcari 认为 Apple 的估值「已被完美定价」，但不会卖出持股。
mainPoints.explanation: 尽管 Apple 的利润率比预期低了一个百分点，其季度营收仍达到 $114 billion，而且在科技股承压之际，股价创下新高，因此 Polcari 表示：「我不会卖掉 Apple。」

keyQuotes: 因此，资金正在离开科技板块，转向市场的其他领域。投资者正在那里找到稳定性和机会。
我认为，从长期来看，MU 是我看好的标的。我持有，公司的投资组合也持有。
这再次表明，买家和投资者正在其他一些板块中寻找未来的机会。
